title: Hana and the Resting Pot
youtube_title: Hana and the Resting Pot | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience gives good food the quiet time it needs to become ready.
summary: Hana helps carry rice pudding to the festival supper but wants to taste it early. She lets the pot rest, sets out bowls, and discovers the grains are creamy only because they had time.
